Provides Syncfusion® Blazor dropdown and selection components including AutoComplete, ComboBox, DropDownList, ListBox, and MultiSelect controls. Supports data binding, filtering, grouping, cascading, templates, and accessibility features for building robust selection interfaces.

Syncfusion® Blazor HeatMap component for creating interactive, data-driven heatmap visualizations. Provides comprehensive features for displaying matrix-based data, cell interaction, legends, tooltips, and color mapping in Blazor applications.
This package contains the Syncfusion® Blazor ImageEditor component.

Provides a Syncfusion® Blazor In-Place Editor component for inline and popup editing scenarios. Supports multiple input types including TextBox, Dropdown, DatePicker, and Rich Text Editor. Optimized for seamless integration in both Blazor Server and Blazor WebAssembly applications.

Comprehensive Blazor Syncfusion® input components including TextBox, MaskedTextBox, NumericTextBox, Color Picker, File Upload, Slider, Rating, Signature, OTP Input, and Speech To Text. Features data validation, formatting, keyboard navigation, and accessibility support for .NET 8+.

Syncfusion® Blazor Interactive Chat component for building conversational AI interfaces. Supports real-time messaging, user interactions, and integration with AI services. Designed for Blazor Server and Blazor WebAssembly applications.
Syncfusion® Blazor Kanban component for building workflow boards in .NET Blazor apps. Supports drag-and-drop cards, swimlanes, filtering, card templates, and dialog editing.

Syncfusion® Provides Blazor layout components for building responsive page structures. Includes Dashboard Layout for grid-based arrangements and Splitter for resizable, collapsible pane management with drag-and-drop support and keyboard accessibility.

Syncfusion® Blazor Linear Gauge component for visualizing measurements and metrics on a linear scale. Supports customizable ranges, pointers, labels, and annotations. Designed for Blazor Server and Blazor WebAssembly applications.

Syncfusion® Blazor ListView component for displaying data in list format with advanced features including sorting, filtering, grouping, and custom templates. Part of Syncfusion® UI component library for .NET 8+.
Syncfusion® Blazor Maps component for rendering interactive maps and spatial visualizations in .NET Blazor apps. Supports markers, bubbles, multi-layer maps, tooltips, zooming/panning, and export.

Syncfusion® Blazor MultiColumnComboBox component enables users to select values from a dropdown list that displays multiple columns of related data. Supports data binding, filtering, virtualization, and customizable column templates for enhanced data presentation in Blazor applications.

Syncfusion® Provides Blazor navigation and menu components for building interactive navigation structures. Includes Accordion, Sidebar, Tabs, Menu Bar, Context Menu, Toolbar, and Tree View with support for keyboard navigation, accessibility features, and customizable templates.

Syncfusion® Provides Blazor notification components for displaying user alerts and feedback. Includes Toast for temporary notifications, Message for persistent alerts, and Skeleton loader for content placeholders during async operations with animations and accessibility support.
Syncfusion® Blazor Pivot Table (PivotView) component for data summarization and analytics in .NET Blazor apps. Supports pivoting, aggregation, drill-down, field lists, calculated fields, and export.

Syncfusion® Provides Blazor popup and overlay components for building interactive dialogs and tooltips. Includes Dialog for modal and modeless windows with drag support, and Tooltip for contextual help with positioning and animations.

Syncfusion® Blazor ProgressBar component displays the progress of a task with visual indication and supports linear and circular progress modes. Features include customizable track colors, segments, labels, and animation effects for enhanced user experience in Blazor applications.

Syncfusion® Blazor Query Builder component enables users to build, validate, and execute complex database queries with a visual interface. Features include customizable columns, operators, filtering rules, and SQL/LINQ query generation for intuitive data filtering and query construction in Blazor applications.

Syncfusion® Blazor Range Navigator component provides an interactive range selection control for navigating and visualizing data over a range. Enables zooming, panning, and selection across large datasets with support for date-time and numeric axes, built for Blazor Server and WebAssembly applications.

Syncfusion® Blazor Ribbon component provides a Microsoft Office-style ribbon interface for organizing complex commands and tools. Features include customizable tabs, groups, items with icons and labels, dropdown menus, split buttons, and quick access toolbar for professional application interfaces in Blazor applications.
Syncfusion® Blazor Rich Text Editor component for composing and formatting HTML content in .NET Blazor apps. Supports toolbar, markdown, paste cleanup, formats, and extensible plugins.

Syncfusion® Blazor Sankey component renders Sankey diagrams to visualize flow between nodes. Supports data binding, custom node/link templates, tooltips, animations, and styling options for nodes and links in Blazor applications.
Syncfusion® Blazor Scheduler component for managing appointments and calendars in .NET Blazor apps. Supports multiple views, recurrence, time zones, resource grouping, drag-and-drop, and export.
Provides support in the Syncfusion® Blazor PDF Viewer component to load PDF documents, add and edit annotations, and add and edit form fields within the PDF.
Syncfusion® delivers AI‑powered Blazor Smart PDF Viewer components that automate PDF workflows such as data redaction, form filling, and AI‑driven summarization and Q&A.

Syncfusion® Provides AI-powered Blazor components that use intelligent APIs to automate common UI tasks. Enables smart data handling, predictive input, and context-aware features for building more efficient user interfaces with minimal configuration.

This package provides the functionality to utilize the features of Syncfusion® Blazor SmartRichTextEditor component, an enhanced Rich Text Editor with integrated AI assistance for content generation, editing, and analysis using Syncfusion AI AssistView.

Syncfusion® Blazor Smith Chart component enables visualization of complex impedance, admittance, and reflection coefficient parameters in transmission line analysis. Designed for RF engineers and electrical professionals, it provides interactive charts with markers, series customization, and export capabilities for Blazor Server and WebAssembly applications.

Syncfusion® Blazor Sparkline component displays lightweight, single-series data visualization charts in a compact cell or inline format. Ideal for dashboards and data summaries, it supports multiple chart types (line, column, area, bar) with interactive tooltips and responsive design for Blazor Server and WebAssembly applications.

Syncfusion® Blazor Spinner component for displaying loading states and progress indicators. Provides lightweight, accessible, and customizable spinners with multiple animation styles, themes, and sizes for modern Blazor applications.

Syncfusion® Provides Blazor button components for building advanced button interfaces. Includes Button Group for grouped controls, Dropdown Menu with nested options, Split Button for dual-action triggers, and Progress Button with loading states and animations.

The Syncfusion® Toolkit for Blazor is a high-performance, open-source collection of lightweight UI components designed to accelerate Blazor application development (Server and WebAssembly). These controls help developers build modern, responsive, and feature-rich web applications faster, with clean code and excellent performance.
Syncfusion® Blazor TreeGrid component for displaying hierarchical tabular data in .NET Blazor apps. Supports row hierarchy, sorting, filtering, paging, editing, virtualization, and export.

Syncfusion® Blazor TreeMap component for visualizing hierarchical data using nested rectangles. Provides customizable colors, labels, drill-down navigation, and interactive features for displaying structured data in Blazor applications.
